revision.reason: Retain the initial scientific model after reviewing the full three-seed source-feedback round. All seeds show higher conditional Pearson than Bao and lower conditional Spearman than MIND, but these are assumption-defined proxies from different populations and measurements, with unknown original weighting and no calibrated source precision or transport model. They reveal a persistent descriptive mismatch, not an identified parameter correction. No extraction, unit, ABI or execution defect is reported. Changing mixture structure or residual dependence solely to shrink both discrepancies would add unsupported tuning; the unchanged scenario remains explicitly assumption-dependent.
